name: ema61_breakout/monthly_weekly_stop_nifty200_tighten
description: Monthly EMA61 breakout, entry only when weekly and daily closes are above EMA61; stop at previous week's low (fixed). No new entries while NIFTY 50 is below its 200-day average (Sensex before mid-2008). While NIFTY 50 is below its 200-day average, open trades' stops are raised to the last completed week's low.
